fixes: **Updating from version 2.0.1 or earlier no longer fails at the backup step.** `update.sh` takes its safety backup using the version that is still running, and the `--once` option it passes did not exist before 2.0.2 — so anyone upgrading from an older release was stopped by "unrecognized arguments: --once" at the exact moment they were doing the right thing. The updater now falls back to the older command automatically. The backup taken is identical; only the way it is asked for changes. ---
